source_integrity.algorithm: Sort relative POSIX path strings; SHA256(UTF8(path) + NUL + binary SHA256(file)) for each file, then SHA256 of the concatenation.

reports.server_apply_payloads: injected through public middleware; native editor transaction

reports.scope: Two simultaneous native editor profiles, real project servers, published analyzer and OS config leases. Selection is supplied to the production controller; no keyboard automation.

validation.failed_attempt_resolution: Edit fixture waited for process ready while configurationPending was still true. It now waits for a real current-model hover and separately asserts readonly rejection before checking an allowed transaction. Failed logs are retained.

experiments.serialized_background: Full 20-run series-priority failed hover gates and was removed. Its raw data are retained.
experiments.outer_provider_priority: A semantic-token self-deadlock invalidated the fast pilot; native acceptance caught it. Scheduler removed.

editor_cancellation_only.reason: Delegating BSL invalidation cancellation to the editor did not reliably improve latency; first modified run regressed completion and diagnostics. Owned uncommitted source and test experiment restored to 75d9108. Native basic test and 33 focused tests passed.

all_serial_requests.note: No final gates evaluated. Runtime is 75d9108, only diagnostic middleware changes during measured operations.

limitations: Linux/VSCodium only. Windows, macOS, VS Code and Remote were not checked.
